gse244832.allowed_use: Training-partition ATAC topic diagnostics only after dataset activation and a separate TaskSpec. RNA and ATAC are same-sample different aliquots and may be compared only at donor-compatible resolution.
gse244832.model_access: Never create cell-to-cell RNA-ATAC pairs. A checkpoint fitted on GSE244832 cells cannot be scored as an external GSE244832 model.

gse281367.allowed_use: Training-partition ATAC topic diagnostics after the donor, native-reference, peak-coordinate, fragment-convention, and TaskSpec gates pass.
gse281367.model_access: The source is ATAC-only and has 12 donors. Cells are not replicates; labels, peak filtering, and topic selection remain donor-grouped and training-only.

gse289173.allowed_use: None under current cisTopic routes because the sealed feature universe is snRNA plus evaluator-only eQTL/ieQTL summaries, with no observed ATAC matrix.
gse289173.model_access: No sealed features or outcomes. Modality incompatibility and lack of an inductive query transform are independently terminal.

gse296875.allowed_use: Training-partition same-nucleus ATAC topic diagnostics after donor/well/reference/peak/QC/missingness authorities pass.
gse296875.model_access: Only outer-training donors may define regions, filtering, LDA topics, model selection, labels, or projections. The pinned cisTopic release cannot transform held nuclei, so held-donor scoring is unavailable.

local_model_roster.missingness: Unassayed, failed-QC, permission-blocked, or unmapped regions remain explicit missingness. A binary zero is allowed only for an assayed frozen region with measured count below the accessibility threshold.

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units. Cells, nuclei, regions, wells, and model topics are not biological replicates.
rules.local_training: Each fit is continual_seen only for its declared outer-training rows. It is target-label-unexposed for a held source only when no row, label, peak definition, or tuning signal from that source entered the fit.
rules.pairing: GSE296875 is same-nucleus. GSE244832 is same-sample different aliquot and never cell-paired.
rules.query_mapping: The pinned release has no inductive transform. Joint fitting or refitting on held or sealed cells is model fitting and is prohibited.
